name: Circuit Breaker Source | Circuit Breaker Buyers
old_description: Get Amped Up For Unbeatable Deals – Buy And Sell Your Electrical Items With Us Today!
about:
Circuit Breaker Source operates from Norco, California, and was founded in 2015. The company presents itself as a buyer and seller of electrical equipment with over 15 years of industry experience, though no individual founders are named and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The business buys and sells new, used, surplus, and obsolete circuit breakers — including molded case, low-voltage, air, vacuum, insulated case, and panelboard types — along with transformers, panels, safety switches, motor control equipment, and isolator switches. It also provides repair and testing, refurbishing, upgrade and design, supply and replacement, and emergency response services. No facility size, headcount, or transaction volumes are published.

Customers include electrical contractors with leftover project material, distributors with slow-moving or discontinued stock, industrial facilities undergoing modernization, and construction companies with surplus inventory. The company evaluates single breakers or bulk lots, requesting nameplate photos, manufacturer, model, ratings, quantity, condition, and location to make offers.

The company states its vision is to lead the industry with quality products, services, and innovative solutions, and its mission is to provide safe electrical equipment and create a sustainable supply chain. It notes it is certified by state and federal law, though no specific standards are cited.
